summary: QUORUM all up: speculating executor, data READ_REQ to n3, local digest on n1, data-driven digests match, no repair, no speculation, rows returned < 2500ms.

Data-driven mismatch, full re-reads, unfiltered merge (newest cell wins, newer tombstone shadows and is repaired), blocking READ_REPAIR_REQ to each stale replica acked before the response. Round-1 resurrection bug and repair-write seam fixed. Remaining minor wrong claim: repair mutation is the full merged partition, not the per-replica diff (RowIteratorMergeListener.java:382-398).
Two replicas down: unavailable 0x1000 {required 2, alive 1} from assureSufficientLiveReplicas before any message; also via CQL.
ONE with n3 slow (4000ms): parallel join + wait speculates a data read to n1 at 2500ms (initial sample latency) and returns it; a 20ms sampled latency speculates at ~20ms. Resolved by DESIGN 11.2.

Corrected expectation holds: all up + silent n3 speculates to n2 and succeeds; n2 down + silent n3 gives NeverSpeculating, read-timeout 0x1200 at 5000ms {received 1, block_for 2, data_present false}; also via CQL.

Warning now reaches the client via ClientWarn on the coordinator's own read (round-1 gap fixed), remote warning not sent, strict >1000; 200000 tombstones gives READ_TOO_MANY_TOMBSTONES read-failure 0x1300 without speculation. But the failure is held until the dormant speculative branch wakes at 2522ms instead of signalling at once (blockFor+failures>contacts, ReadCallback.java:247-248): parallel join has no failure budget.

Memtable + per-sstable reads in descending max timestamp, bloom/key-range skip, early stop at an older-than-partition-deletion sstable, Cells.reconcile ties (tombstone, then greater value), tombstones kept in replica response and filtered for the client.
